assumptions: Effective isotropic E=1200 MPa, provisional short-term strain screen 1.5%. Uniform full-width beam idealization; off-centre plate/torsion and local nose strain need the separate nonlinear screen, which is also conditional. Material/fill/layer bonding not calibrated. Thickness interval is a screening envelope, not measured print error. Seated normal force, grip/release and long-term strain relaxation require physical evidence.
